copy.title: pulsecheck

prompt.asset_type: text-free master artwork for a coordinated open-source launch identity
prompt.primary_request: Create the Kinetic Pulse visual direction for pulsecheck, a cli described as: Know what is up before your users do. Depict a dynamic uptime pulse moving through a network of endpoints, with bold concentric waves and clear status transitions.
prompt.style: bold kinetic graphic design, layered paper depth, radiant pulse rings, sharp contemporary poster art
prompt.composition: Adaptable composition for 2:1, 16:9, square, and 4:5 crops; quiet copy-safe space on the left in wide crops and in the lower third for square or portrait crops; main visual focus in the upper-right center; important detail away from all edges
prompt.constraints: No text, letters, numbers, code, logos, badges, watermarks, screenshots, interface labels, people, or third-party marks
